changes_made.explanation: Removed models that are used for evaluation only (GPT-2, GPT-1, BERT) rather than generation. Consolidated duplicate entries and simplified output descriptions.
Normalized metric variants to base forms (BLEU instead of G-BLEU/human-BLEU, Perplexity instead of g-PPL/d-PPL/t-PPL). Kept the core metrics used: BLEU, Style Accuracy, Perplexity, BERTScore.
GPT-2 and GPT-1 are used for perplexity calculation as automatic metrics, not as LLM judges evaluating outputs after generation. This does not qualify as LLM-as-judge.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on text style transfer using a Delete-and-Generate approach with Transformer encoder-decoder architecture. It uses comprehensive automatic evaluation (BLEU, style accuracy, perplexity, BERTScore) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of evaluation-only models from the generation models list.
